title: [3.x] Toggle Button hover-style are broken
body:
### Tested versions

- reproducible [6c3f393623621b89802f5a1bb96bfd2086add27c]
- not reproducible v3.6.stable.official [de2f0f147]

### System information

Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS, GTX1060 6Gb 570.153.02 

### Issue description

Toggle-Button style are messed up in current **upstream 3.x**, it's look like default-style keep popping.

- hover

### Steps to reproduce

1. select current 3.x branch
2. update to latest upstream
3. compile template (additional flags added for speedup compilation)
```
scons target=release_debug tools=no optimize=size debug_symbols=no deprecated=no disable_3d=yes disable_advanced_gui=yes
```
4. make sure compiled 
5. export build (or run web build)
6. click button
7. hover button
